statement:
(a : ℕ → ℝ) (σ : ℕ → ℕ) (hσ : Function.Injective σ) (n : ℕ) :
  Series (a ∘ σ) n = ∑ k ∈ Finset.image σ (Finset.range n), a k
name: Series_image
content:
For a sequence `a : ℕ → ℝ` and an injective `σ : ℕ → ℕ`, we have that:
`Series (a ∘ σ) n = ∑ k ∈ image σ (range n), a k` holds for any `n`.
